description: User-confirmed (확정) Atlas rules with byte-exact source records, machine-readable parameters and pre-registered review triggers. Validated by governance/rule_registry.py. Decision lineage (governance/rule_refs.py) names these ids.
scope_note: Registry entries record what the user confirmed; PENDING_USER_DECISION rows name items a ratification record explicitly left undecided and carry no parameters. They grant no order, capital, production or REAL authority; each row's modes field repeats the record's own scope. Parameters are transcriptions pinned to JSON pointers in the source record; the record, not this file, is the authority.
